params.termsHash: keccak256 of the canonical job spec JSON, agreed by both sides        before money moves. This is what evidence is judged against; it cannot        be rewritten later, which is the point.

accept(uint256).notice: Buyer accepts delivery: seller is paid, commission taken.

claimArbiterSilence(uint256).notice: Arbiter produced no ruling within ARBITRATION_TIMEOUT. Funds return to         the buyer and the job is recorded as Unresolved — the third column of         the ledger, not silently counted as a failure.

claimExpiry(uint256).notice: Nothing delivered by the deadline: buyer recovers, nobody pays a fee.

claimSilence(uint256).notice: Pre-agreed default when the buyer goes silent inside the review window.         The direction was fixed at job creation, in public, before money moved.

createJob(address,uint64,uint64,bool,byt.notice: Buyer creates and funds a job in one transaction.

deliver(uint256,bytes32).notice: Seller submits the evidence bundle hash. Only the hash goes on-chain;         the bundle itself lives off-chain and is content-addressed.

dispute(uint256).notice: Either party opens a dispute by posting the stake. Stake goes to the         winner, which is what makes frivolous disputes expensive.

quoteFee(uint256).notice: Fee that would be charged if this job released right now.

rule(uint256,bool).notice: Arbiter's ruling. paySeller=true releases to the seller (fee applies),         false refunds the buyer in full (no fee).
